incidents.reportText: During coil tubing ops on WH-44, noticed severe H2S release from the BOP annular preventer seal. Gas detectors triggered and area evacuated immediately. The secondary seal appears to be completely blown.
Heavy vibration observed in GGS-2 Plant main compressor during startup. The foundation bolts on the non-drive end are loose, causing significant swaying of the discharge piping.
Flare System Knockout Drum liquid level transmitter is showing erratic readings, fluctuating between 40% and 80% rapidly. Operator has to manually drain the drum every 2 hours to prevent carryover.
Housekeeping issue at Workover Rig #12. Empty chemical drums stacked near the mud tank without proper securing. Instructed roustabouts to move them to the designated storage area.
Main breaker for Subsurface ESP Pump tripped with a loud bang, followed by smoke from the VSD cabinet. Thermography showed temperatures exceeding 120C on phase B. Suspect insulation failure.
Kelly bushing on Drilling Rig DR-03 is badly worn out and slipping during high torque drilling. The rotary table is also making a grinding noise. Drilling halted for inspection.
Central Gathering Facility inlet manifold header has a minor seep from the 12-inch flange gasket. The leak is contained, but the gasket needs replacement during the next shutdown.
Crew at Drilling Rig DR-03 conducting a toolbox talk before lifting casing joints. Good participation and safety awareness demonstrated by the derrickman.

Excavator struck the 8-inch Crude Export Flowline during trenching work nearby, causing a 2-inch gash. Pipeline was live at 30 kg/cm2. Fortunately, the pipe didn't rupture fully, but work was stopped instantly.
Separator Vessel 04 PSV (Pressure Safety Valve) isolation valve was found closed during routine rounds. This leaves the vessel without overpressure protection. Valve opened immediately and locked.
GGS Plant 01 crude transfer pump seal is leaking approximately 10 drops per minute. Drip pan placed, but requires maintenance to replace the mechanical seal soon.
Walkway grating near Separator Vessel 04 has a missing clip, causing it to wobble slightly when stepped on. Work order raised for structural team to fix.

During subsea intervention on the Subsea Manifold Block, ROV reported a sudden gas breakthrough from the production riser base. Significant bubble plume visible on sonar. Emergency shutdown initiated.
Deck Crane #02 load moment indicator (LMI) screen went blank during a heavy lift from the supply vessel. Operator had to rely on hand signals and guess the radius. Lift suspended.
Offshore Platform Alpha firewater ring main pressure dropped below 6 kg/cm2 for 15 minutes due to a jockey pump trip. Standby pump kicked in, but the primary pump needs investigation.
Lifejackets in muster station B on Offshore Platform Alpha were found untidily stored after the weekly drill. Organized them properly as per the safety plan.

alerts.title: BLOWOUT RISK: Subsea Manifold Block riser gas breakthrough detected on sonar.
ELECTRICAL FLASH: VSD cabinet for Subsurface ESP Pump exceeding 120C.
TOXIC GAS: Uncontrolled H2S release from Wellhead WH-44 BOP annular preventer.
STRUCTURAL FAILURE: GGS-2 Plant main compressor foundation bolts loose causing heavy piping vibration.
PIPELINE INTEGRITY: Crude Export Flowline damaged by third-party excavation activity.
LIFTING HAZARD: Deck Crane #02 LMI failure during active lift operations.

workerNarratives.narrative: Was doing wireline op and smelled strong rotten egg odor near the tree. The lower master valve gland was leaking gas right in our faces. We had to run and grab SCBAs.
The grating on the cellar deck gave way while I was walking. I almost fell through to the sea, caught myself on the handrail. The supports are completely rusted out.
Found the LOTO lock on the main export pump MCC broken and lying on the floor. Someone tried to energize it while mechanical team was still working on the coupling.
The relief valve discharge line for the first stage separator is vibrating so much it broke its U-bolt support. Looks like it might crack the weld if not stopped.
Noticed some oil soaked rags left near the diesel generator exhaust. Picked them up and put them in the hazardous waste bin.
The driller’s cabin AC is dripping water right onto the electrical junction box on the floor. Put a bucket for now, need electrical team to seal the box.
